package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for save_in_loop_full_model: GORM Save(...) writes full models inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule295PositiveRecord struct {
	ID      int
	Name    string
	Version int
	Hash    string
	Payload []byte
}

func scenario295Positive(db *gorm.DB, items []Rule295PositiveRecord) error {
	for i := range items {
		items[i].Version++
		items[i].Hash = "recalculated"
		if err := db.Save(&items[i]).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
